title: Aureline M5 learning-mode profiles
description: Boundary schema for the learning-mode-profile manifest. A learning-mode profile is an opt-in, user-owned dial over Aureline's learnability surfaces: it tunes tip intensity, jargon level, educational-AI explanation posture, and a mutation guardrail, and records dismissals, bookmarks, lifecycle controls, and a change history. A profile MUST NOT change any authority boundary, drift the command graph, or store state anywhere but user-owned local-first storage; it MUST NOT force blocking onboarding (no expert is ever trapped). Scope is explicit: a profile is either user_local or workspace_opt_in, is never committed to the repository, and is never shared with collaborators, so onboarding preferences cannot leak into shared repo state. Educational AI keeps explain and do separate: any posture that can prepare a 'do' MUST route it through the standard preview/approval model and a guardrail that permits a fenced do; there is no unfenced mutation value. Progress (dismissals, bookmarks, change history) is user-owned, local-first, reversible, and inspectable in settings, Help/About, diagnostics, and support export — never hidden inside a transient overlay. Optional portable-profile sync is allowed only when disclosed; an undisclosed synced profile is a masquerade that narrows below Stable. Every profile exposes enable, disable, reset, and narrow controls (plus pause, snooze, resume); each control is command-backed, keyboard reachable, reversible, inspectable, never a silent write, and never mutates the workspace. Each profile's verdict is the strictest verdict folded from its safety, scope, ownership, exposure, control, and sync evidence; the manifest carries the narrowest overall verdict. Raw URLs, raw absolute paths, and raw credential material MUST NOT appear; the schema carries opaque ids, typed vocabulary, and short privacy-safe labels only. The surface-family taxonomy aligns with schemas/learning/m5-feature-family-learning-rails.schema.json and the posture/verdict vocabulary with schemas/learning/guided-learning-contracts.schema.json. Adding a new record_kind, preset, profile state, scope, tip intensity, jargon level, posture, guardrail, control kind, change kind, sync posture, or surface family is additive-minor; repurposing an existing value is breaking.

schema_version.description: Integer schema version for learning-mode-profile records. Current value is 1. Bumped only on breaking payload changes.

opaque_id.description: Opaque, stable identifier. Raw URLs, raw absolute paths, and raw secret material MUST NOT appear.

reason_array.description: Named narrowing reasons. Empty when the verdict is qualified_stable.

qualification_verdict.description: Derived lifecycle verdict for a profile or the overall manifest.

learning_mode_preset.description: The named starting point a profile is derived from. Learner-facing presets keep explain-before-act on; only expert_minimal may opt out of forced pre-explanation (never out of the mutation fence).

profile_state.description: Current lifecycle state of a learning-mode profile.

profile_scope.description: Whether a profile is owned by the user (portable across workspaces) or opt-in per workspace.

tip_intensity.description: How insistently a profile surfaces tips. Every level is dismissable and inline-friendly; no level may block first useful work.

jargon_level.description: How much specialist vocabulary a profile leaves unexplained.

ai_explanation_posture.description: How the educational AI behaves when it could prepare an action. Explain and do stay separate at every posture: any 'do' is a preview that still rides the standard preview/approval/rollback fence.

mutation_guardrail.description: The guardrail in front of any mutation the educational AI or a guided surface would prepare. Every variant fences mutation; there is deliberately no unfenced value.

control_kind.description: The kind of lifecycle transition a control performs.

change_kind.description: The kind of change captured by a change-history event.

sync_posture.description: How a profile's state moves across machines. Local-only is live-authoritative; portable-profile sync is allowed only when disclosed and narrows below Stable.

data_ownership_class.description: Ownership class of profile state. Only user_owned_local_first qualifies Stable.

m5_learning_surface_family.description: One M5 feature family a profile applies to.

opt_in_explicit.description: Whether the user explicitly opted this scope in. A workspace_opt_in profile MUST set this true.

repo_committed.description: Whether the profile is committed to the repository. MUST be false.

shared_with_collaborators.description: Whether the profile is shared with collaborators. MUST be false.

reversible.description: Whether a dismissal can be undone. MUST be true.

user_owned_local.description: Whether the dismissal state is user-owned and local-first. MUST be true.

follows_profile_scope.description: Whether dismissals follow the owning profile's scope rather than leaking wider. MUST be true.

user_owned_local.description: Whether the bookmark state is user-owned and local-first. MUST be true.

exportable_in_portable_profile.description: Whether bookmarks travel in the user's portable-profile export.

reversible.description: Whether the transition is reversible. MUST be true.

inspectable.description: Whether the control surfaces in the action log / inspector. MUST be true.

silent_write_allowed.description: Whether the control may write profile state silently. MUST be false.

mutates_workspace.description: Whether the control mutates workspace state. MUST be false.

user_initiated.description: Whether the change was user-initiated. MUST be true — no silent changes.

inspectable_in_support_export.description: Whether the event is visible in support export. MUST be true.

in_settings.description: Visible in settings. MUST be true.

in_help_about.description: Visible in Help/About. MUST be true.

in_diagnostics.description: Visible in diagnostics. MUST be true.

in_support_export.description: Visible in support export. MUST be true.

hidden_in_transient_overlay_only.description: Whether the state is reachable only through a transient overlay. MUST be false.

educational_ai_uses_standard_preview_app.description: Whether the educational AI routes any prepared 'do' through the standard preview/approval model. MUST be true.

explain_before_act_default.description: Whether explain-before-act is on by default. Learner presets MUST keep this true; only expert_minimal may turn it off.

authority_boundary_change_allowed.description: Whether the profile is allowed to change an authority boundary. MUST be false.

command_graph_unchanged.description: Whether the command graph stays unchanged under this profile. MUST be true.

blocking_onboarding_allowed.description: Whether the profile may force blocking onboarding. MUST be false — experts are never trapped.

sync_disclosed.description: Whether portable-profile sync is disclosed to the user. A synced profile MUST set this true.

controls.description: Lifecycle controls. MUST include enable, disable, reset, and narrow.

allOf.description: A do-capable posture must route its do through the standard preview/approval model and a guardrail that permits a fenced do.
A portable-profile-synced profile must disclose its sync.

contract_refs.description: Schema, docs, and contract refs this manifest consumes.
